about: Reviewed per-game results shipped with rtxForge and shown at loew.fi/rtxforge. A user's own Working or Problem result always comes first. Match by Steam appid, or by executable name for non-Steam games. verdict is Working or Problem, chosen by a curator; package is a lock.json or feeder.json id; note is generic. reports lists the reviewed GitHub beta reports behind the verdict: setup and NR/MFG results only, never a GPU model, driver, path or personal note. Add one with: python3 scripts/compat_list.py add-report (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).
